en.headline: Coleman Wong reaches first ATP Tour semi-final and enters top 100
en.dek: The 22-year-old Hong Kong player defeated Jenson Brooksby in straight sets at the Los Cabos Open after earlier upsetting world No. 12 Jiri Lehecka.
body: Hong Kong’s Coleman Wong has reached the first ATP Tour semi-final of his career at the Mifel Tennis Open in Los Cabos, Mexico, and will enter the top 100 of the PIF ATP Rankings for the first time.

Wong, 22, defeated American Jenson Brooksby 6-1, 7-5 in the quarter-finals. He had earlier staged a comeback to beat top seed and world No. 12 Jiri Lehecka 1-6, 6-3, 6-4 in the second round, his biggest career win by ranking.

The result makes Wong the first male player from Hong Kong to break into the ATP top 100. He was due to face French qualifier Arthur Géa in the semi-finals. Wong had already reached tour-level quarter-finals in Hong Kong and Delray Beach earlier this season and won his first ATP Challenger title in May.

zh.headline: 黃澤林首闖ATP巡迴賽四強 成港產男網首人入百強
zh.dek: 22歲港將於洛斯卡沃斯公開賽直落兩盤擊敗美國球員布碌士比，稍早亦爆冷淘汰世界排名第12的列赫卡。
body: 香港網球手黃澤林在墨西哥洛斯卡沃斯公開賽打入職業生涯首個ATP巡迴賽四強，並將首次躋身PIF ATP世界排名百強。
22歲的黃澤林在四分之一決賽以6-1、7-5直落兩盤擊敗美國球員布碌士比。他稍早在次輪以1-6、6-3、6-4逆轉淘汰頭號種子、世界排名第12的捷克球員列赫卡，締造個人職業生涯以對手排名計最大勝利。
黃澤林成為首位打入ATP世界排名百強的香港男網選手。他原定於四強對陣法國球員蓋亞。黃澤林本季已先後在香港及德爾雷比奇站打入四分之一決賽，並於5月奪得首個ATP挑戰賽冠軍。
